rose.definition: A flower with soft petals, often having thorns on its stem.

tulip.definition: A spring flower that grows from a bulb and has a cup-shaped bloom.

sunflower.definition: A tall plant with a large yellow flower and edible seeds.

daisy.definition: A small flower with a yellow centre and white petals.

lily.definition: A flower grown from a bulb, often with a strong sweet smell.

daffodil.definition: A yellow spring flower with a trumpet-shaped centre.

violet.definition: A small plant with purple flowers.

orchid.definition: A tropical flower with unusual shapes and bright colours.

carnation.definition: A flower with many soft petals, often used in bouquets.

lavender.definition: A small purple plant with a strong pleasant smell.

oak-tree.definition: A large tree with broad leaves and acorns.

pine-tree.definition: A tall evergreen tree with thin needle-like leaves.

apple-tree.definition: A tree grown for its round fruit, which may be red, green, or yellow.

cherry-tree.definition: A tree that produces small round cherries.

palm-tree.definition: A tall tree with long leaves growing in warm climates.

hedge.definition: A row of bushes planted close together as a boundary.

bush.definition: A small woody plant with many branches.

ivy.definition: A climbing plant with green leaves that grows on walls and trees.

vine.definition: A climbing or trailing plant with a long thin stem.

fern.definition: A plant with soft green leaves and no flowers.

shovel.definition: A hand tool with a broad blade for digging soil.

rake.definition: A garden tool with a row of teeth for gathering leaves or loosening soil.

watering-can.definition: A container with a handle and narrow spout for watering plants.

wheelbarrow.definition: A tool with a large open tray and one or two wheels.

hose.definition: A long flexible tube used for carrying water.

garden-gloves.definition: Strong gloves worn to protect hands while gardening.

pruner.definition: A tool with sharp blades for cutting small branches.

trowel.definition: A small hand tool with a pointed blade for planting.

lawn-mower.definition: A machine with rotating blades used to cut grass.

spade.definition: A digging tool with a flat or pointed blade.

pitchfork.definition: A long-handled tool with pointed prongs for lifting or loosening material.

sprinkler.definition: A device that sprays water over plants or grass.

root.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water.

stem.definition: The main stalk of a plant that supports leaves and flowers.

leaf.definition: A flat green part of a plant that uses light to make food.

petal.definition: The colourful part of a flower that attracts insects.

branch.definition: A woody part that grows from a tree trunk or large branch.

bark.definition: The rough outer covering of a tree trunk.

bud.definition: A small unopened flower that will open later.

seed.definition: A small object from which a new plant grows.

thorn.definition: A sharp pointed growth on a plant that can hurt you.

berry.definition: A small soft fruit that may grow on a bush or tree.

butterfly.definition: A flying insect with colourful wings.

ladybug.definition: A small red or black insect with spots on its back.

bee.definition: A flying insect that collects nectar and makes honey.

worm.definition: A small animal with a long soft body and no legs.

snail.definition: A small slow-moving animal with a spiral shell.

ant.definition: A small insect with six legs that lives in organised groups.

caterpillar.definition: A young insect that looks like a worm before becoming a butterfly or moth.

spider.definition: A small animal with eight legs that makes webs.

dragonfly.definition: A flying insect with a long body and two pairs of wings.

grasshopper.definition: A jumping insect with long back legs that eats plants.

lawn.definition: An area covered with short green plants.

flower-bed.definition: An area of soil where flowers are grown.

path.definition: A narrow track through a garden for walking.

fence.definition: A barrier made of posts or wire around land.

gate.definition: A door in a fence or wall that allows people to enter.

greenhouse.definition: A building with glass walls or a roof for growing plants.

bird-feeder.definition: A container filled with seeds that attracts birds.

garden-shed.definition: A small building used for storing garden tools.

birdbath.definition: A shallow bowl or basin where birds drink and bathe.

compost-bin.definition: A container where plant and food waste turns into soil.

flower.definition: The colourful part of a plant that often grows from a stem.

tree.definition: A tall plant with a woody trunk and branches.

grass.definition: Green plants with narrow blades that cover the ground.

gloves.definition: Hand coverings that protect your hands while working.

bird.definition: An animal with feathers, wings, and a beak.
